safety: Wear your badge visibly at all times.
Follow the PPE rules posted at each area (safety glasses, lab coat, safety shoes).
Clean rooms: enter only after gowning training.
Report injuries, near misses and unsafe conditions immediately to your manager or EHS.
In an emergency: leave by the nearest exit, go to the assembly point, do not use lifts.
